body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ c9a6f6767dba599a532bf1708d6d46c37f06637e

Verdict FINDINGS

1. crates/app/src/project/tool_body_wire.rs:181 — The loader checks piece facet counts but not coordinates. A same-count corrupted piece is accepted. In a standalone repro, scaling piece 0 XY coordinates by 0.1 loaded successfully; removing piece 1 then shrank the retained body's collision radius from 14.142 mm to 1.414 mm. Validate that piece geometry equals the combined mesh, or derive one canonical mesh.
2. crates/ui/src/state_tool_body_assembly.rs:33 — The editor always passes target_piece=None. After head and adapter both carry MCS, attaching a third piece with target MCS and piece CSW fails as ambiguous. The same repro succeeds with target_piece=1. Expose the target piece selector.
3. crates/ui/src/state.rs:298 — The PR grows files already over the AGENTS.md ~400-line limit: state.rs 4467→4489, schema.rs 720→724, egui_app/tests.rs 5308→5309. No applicable exemption was found.

Checks:
- Named app suites: 35 passed. Named UI assembly suite: 2 passed.
- cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: RED. App suites passed. Two GPU tests failed because Metal found no graphics adapters: egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds (crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1898) and headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero (crates/ui/tests/shell.rs:12). This environment cannot establish a green gate.
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings: GREEN.
- No added production unwrap/expect/panic. No changed golden lines. No PR changes to snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependencies, .github, or scripts. Body has Changelog: and Fixes #361.
- Mutation results below use the four app assembly pins. RED means the pin caught the bypass; GREEN means it survived. No compile failures. All temporary edits restored; restored assembly suite passed 4/4. Worktree diff was empty.

Mutations RED: serialization, ambiguous_auto, single_piece_removal, remove_bounds, spindle_frame_mismatch, missing_target_name.

Mutations GREEN: lathe_frame_mismatch, spun_refusal, empty_assembly, csys_empty_name, csys_nonfinite_origin, spindle_invalid_axis, spindle_invalid_offset, target_piece_bounds, incoming_no_csys, target_no_csys, missing_piece_name, dto_count, csys_invalid_z, csys_invalid_x, attach_loaded_piece_missing_entity, attach_loaded_piece_not_tool, attach_loaded_piece_fits, attach_loaded_piece_no_body, remove_piece_missing_entity, remove_piece_not_tool, remove_piece_fits, remove_piece_no_body, find_target_by_name_ambiguity, find_piece_by_name_ambiguity, find_complementary_target_ambiguity, find_complementary_piece_ambiguity, find_complementary_target_missing, find_complementary_piece_missing.
